title: The Aron--Rueda zero-subspace problem
summary: We determine the exact finite-dimensional threshold in the zero-subspace problem of Aron and Rueda for complex homogeneous polynomials. More precisely, for every $d$ and $k$ we determine the least $m$ such that every $d$-homogeneous polynomial on $\mathbb{C}^m$ vanishes on a $k$-dimensional linear subspace. We also determine the exact threshold for arbitrary polynomials of degree at most $d$ to be constant on a $k$-dimensional linear subspace. The two thresholds are different.
